actions.agency_adoption: Reasoned inference from affirmative official submission/action record, not direct recovery of an adoption order: OAL identifies this specific package as a regular rulemaking action. Government Code 11343(a),(g) requires transmission of the agency's certified adopted/amended regulation for filing. That establishes an agency-adopted/submitted package, distinct from OAL approval.

actions.text_route_limit: The recovered agency route contains proposal/modified-proposal materials; do not represent that specific body as the certified final adoption text solely from the OAL record.
actions.oal_outcome: Not established by acquired records; the recent-action entry does not say approved, withdrawn or rejected. Absence from current pending and approved-date tables is not the basis of any status conclusion.
actions.selection_decision: Include the existing governing instrument and the identified agency-adopted/submitted amendment package, with its exact final body and operative status to be acquired downstream. No additional instrument identity depends on knowing the OAL outcome now.

bounded_review: Current OAL pending/recent-action records, October 1 and January 1 approved-date tables, other effective dates and disapproval index; agency amendment pages, current compilations and actual CAEATFA minutes. No affirmative OAL outcome was recovered for either action.
